foundry_integration_redirect.redirect_resolution: The accepted foundry_integration requirement is preserved as an intelligence metadata contract. It does not revive foundry as a live microservice; ADR-0335-retired foundry responsibilities map to intelligence model-routing, provider-pool, credential-resolver, eval, guardrails, audit-tap, and to the cloud-intelligence gateway for provider ingress budget evidence where applicable.

foundry_integration_redirect.preserved_namespace_only: oyatie.foundry.* may remain only as the ADR-0247 Cedar principal namespace recorded in retirement authority.

owner_surfaces.responsibility: consume env_tier and choose only model profiles whose default class is allowed for that tier
expose metadata tags used by model-routing: cheap_or_small, staging_approved, production_grade, non_prod_only, prod_approved
resolve credential handles only after env_tier and cost-budget evidence has been validated by upstream domain/usecase layers
provide eval evidence refs proving prod-tier defaults meet production-grade policy before promotion
fail closed when env_tier, model-default, budget, or policy evidence is missing or mismatched
enforce ingress budget-admission evidence and emit usage/budget metadata without accepting missing or cross-tier evidence

test.selection_note: The accepted small/cheap test-tier default maps to a non-production model profile selected by metadata; it is not permission to send test traffic to production-grade models.

staging.selection_note: Staging may evaluate production-candidate profiles only with explicit eval and budget evidence; it does not imply live customer production traffic.

prod.selection_note: Production-grade selection requires policy/eval/budget evidence and remains a contract target until runtime implementation and review gates exist.

credential handle issuance and cloud-intelligence ingress dispatch
using retired foundry manifests, crates, or cost-budget docs as live authority
